mission: Sharon Fellowship Church is a community of Christian believers who are devoted to God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Together in a spirit of unity, we cooperate in fellowship, propagate the Gospel, and are committed to stewardship.
vision: Empowering the believer to live a Christ-centered life.
Reaching our community and the world with the Gospel.
history: SFC Chicago took form in January of 1999, with the first service held at Br. James Oommen's house, led by the late Rev. P. C. Oommen with a few members. The church worshipped in several rental facilities across Illinois until, with much prayer, work, and sacrifice, God opened the door to purchase a church building in Kenosha in 2004. Our first service in the current facility was held on March 28, 2004.
